lines: NBQ Platinum Card is a credit card which comes with special privileges, including Priority Pass airport lounge access, travel insurance, and hotel and travel discounts. It also comes with a higher spending limit and up to 55 days free credit
Use your card without PIN upto AED 500/-
Priority Pass Lounge access at over 1300 lounges in Various airports around the world
Get cashback on your shopping, with free credit for up to 55 days.
